interpretation: Experimentally universal T-helper epitopes reach 2/25 DR molecules at EL %Rank < 1 and 5/25 at < 5 on this panel. The strong-binder tier is therefore a high-specificity, low-sensitivity criterion: it does not reproduce the textbook universal epitopes, so a peptide that does clear it across many molecules is more promiscuous than they are, not merely 'a strong binder'.
